notes.title: Update v1.0.1 AI difficulty improvement
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we just updated the game to version 1.0.1:
- The AI in the previous version was extremely hard in some random cases where the AI preferred to match a kind-of-4 match, so now we improve it easier.
- The CG (just for DLC) is unlock at the last two match of each Grandmaster (the AI girl in game) now will unlock the first two match. It mean CG will be unlock earlier.
